studies.title: Semaglutide + RT preserves lean mass
studies.abstract: Two-arm RCT (n=180) comparing semaglutide alone vs semaglutide + 3x/wk resistance training. Lean mass loss 4.2 kg vs 1.1 kg favoring RT arm (p<0.001).

studies.title: Microneedling + topical minoxidil for AGA
studies.abstract: 12-week RCT (n=80) shows microneedling + 5% minoxidil produces 1.7x hair density increase vs minoxidil alone.

studies.title: Sleep restriction blunts MPS response to RT
studies.abstract: Crossover trial (n=24) shows 4h sleep restriction reduces post-RT muscle protein synthesis by 27%.

studies.title: Rapamycin in aged mice — ITP follow-up
studies.abstract: Preprint: rapamycin at 14ppm extends median lifespan by 21% in 24mo C57BL/6J.

studies.title: Creatine 5g/day vs 10g/day — meta-analysis
studies.abstract: Meta-analysis (k=14, n=872) — no hypertrophy benefit at 10g/day over 5g/day.

studies.title: Examine: New evidence on ashwagandha and sleep
studies.abstract: Review of 3 new RCTs on ashwagandha for sleep onset latency.
